# DER encodings of every xIRI record type, one per line: <RecordName> <hex>.
# <RecordName>/bare is the same record with its mandatory members only, and
# <RecordName>/sparse holds optional structures present with their mandatory members.
# Regenerate from the repository root with:
#   go test ./li/iri/ -run TestGoldenEncodings -update-golden
# These pin the output of the shared encoder so an encoder change has to
# show which records it altered. Do not edit by hand.
